title: lineage
description: One row per copy of a kernel or legacy file. Ports start from the canonical row of a subject (D-156).

id.description: <subject>/<copy>, unique; subject names the kernel or design slug

kind.description: canonical is the one copy a port starts from; one canonical row per subject

source.description: the file as harvested, in the publish form of tools/publish-paths.mjs (fab-knowledge:, fab-work-directory:, ~/ or a sibling repository name), or the repo path when the copy only exists in the repo; tools/test-support/originals-root.ts localSource reads it

sha256.description: sha256 of the source file's bytes

fixes.description: one line per fix this copy carries over the others, each with file and line

dest.description: repo path where the port or copy lands; null when the repo keeps no copy
